note: Second-weakest course, and it has its own anti-pattern: FOUR questions ask what 'the cheat sheet says' or what 'the lab notes' (automl-q3, q6, q8, q10, creditcard-q7). That is recall of a document's authority, not reasoning - the same fault as pdi-2hr-lab's 'why does the guide insist'. The underlying questions are often strong; drop the appeal and they stand on their own. The Prerequisites module is almost entirely setup trivia.
